---
title: "`r params$species`"
params:
  species: null
  output_dir: null
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

sp <- params$species
csv_dir <- file.path(params$output_dir, "csv")
# This page is rendered to `output_dir/species/<species>.html`, while its
# PNG/HTML plots were written by `evaluate()` to
# `output_dir/plots/<species>/` - a sibling of `species/`, hence `..`.
# `plots_dir` is only used as the link written into the page: files are
# looked up under `plots_fs_dir` (absolute), since the page may be executed
# from a throwaway project (parallel rendering) where `..` isn't
# `output_dir`.
plots_dir <- file.path("..", "plots", sp)
plots_fs_dir <- file.path(params$output_dir, "plots", sp)

# This page is rendered from `species/`, the shared helpers sit one level up.
source(file.path("..", "_common.R"))

species_stats <- read_csv_safe(file.path(csv_dir, "species_stats.csv"))
min_obs <- read_min_obs(csv_dir)
rrmse_comparison <- read_csv_safe(
  file.path(csv_dir, "species_rrmse_comparison.csv")
)
failed_usms <- read_csv_safe(file.path(csv_dir, "failed_usms.csv"))
deteriorated_usm <- read_csv_safe(file.path(csv_dir, "Deteriorated_USM.csv"))
usm_thresholds <- read_csv_safe(file.path(csv_dir, "usm_thresholds.csv"))
rrmse_per_usm <- read_csv_safe(file.path(csv_dir, "rRMSE_per_usm.csv"))

sp_comp <- if (!is.null(rrmse_comparison)) {
  rrmse_comparison[rrmse_comparison$species == sp, , drop = FALSE]
}
sp_failed_usms <- if (!is.null(failed_usms)) {
  failed_usms$situation[failed_usms$species == sp]
}
sp_deteriorated <- if (!is.null(deteriorated_usm)) {
  deteriorated_usm[deteriorated_usm$species == sp, , drop = FALSE]
}

# Scatter plot files for this species live under `plots_dir`. Ordered from
# most to least degraded using `sp_comp`'s rRMSE ratio (falls back to
# filesystem order - alphabetical by variable - if that data isn't
# available).
scatter_files <- basename(
  Sys.glob(file.path(plots_fs_dir, "*_scatter_plot.html"))
)
scatter_paths <- file.path(plots_dir, scatter_files)
scatter_vars <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(scatter_files)
scatter_vars <- sub("_scatter_plot$", "", scatter_vars)

ratio <- rep(NA_real_, length(scatter_vars))
has_ratio <- !is.null(sp_comp) && "rrmse_ratio" %in% names(sp_comp)
if (has_ratio) {
  ratio <- sp_comp$rrmse_ratio[match(scatter_vars, sp_comp$variable)]
}
ord <- order(-ifelse(is.na(ratio), -Inf, ratio))
scatter_paths <- scatter_paths[ord]
scatter_vars <- scatter_vars[ord]
scatter_ratio <- ratio[ord]

# Only the variables with a scatter plot (the degraded ones) get a link.
scatter_href <- function(vars) {
  ifelse(vars %in% scatter_vars, paste0("#", scatter_id(vars)), NA_character_)
}
```

```{=html}
<script>
// Scatter plots are collapsible `<details>`: open the one targeted by a
// link (e.g. a variable badge, or a cell of the homepage heatmap), whether
// it comes from another page (URL hash) or from this one (click).
function openScatter(id) {
  var el = document.getElementById(decodeURIComponent(id));
  if (el && el.tagName === "DETAILS") {
    el.open = true;
    el.scrollIntoView();
  }
}
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
  if (location.hash) openScatter(location.hash.slice(1));
});
window.addEventListener("hashchange", function() {
  openScatter(location.hash.slice(1));
});
document.addEventListener("click", function(event) {
  var link = event.target.closest('a[href^="#scatter-"]');
  if (link) openScatter(link.getAttribute("href").slice(1));
});
function toggleScatters(open) {
  document.querySelectorAll("details.scatter").forEach(function(el) {
    el.open = open;
  });
}
</script>
```

## Variables

### Degraded variables

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
if (is.null(sp_comp) || nrow(sp_comp) == 0) {
  cat("::: {.callout-note}\nNo comparison done.\n:::\n\n")
} else {
  # `status` already accounts for the minimum number of observations
  # (variables without enough of them are "Not tested").
  by_status <- split(sp_comp$variable, sp_comp$status)
  cat(sprintf(
    "<p><strong>%d variable(s) critical</strong> (major rRMSE increase)<br>\n%s</p>\n", # nolint: line_length_linter
    length(by_status[["Critical"]]),
    tag_list(by_status[["Critical"]], "Critical", href = scatter_href)
  ))
  cat(sprintf(
    "<p><strong>%d variable(s) warning</strong> (minor rRMSE increase)<br>\n%s</p>\n", # nolint: line_length_linter
    length(by_status[["Warning"]]),
    tag_list(by_status[["Warning"]], "Warning", href = scatter_href)
  ))
  cat(sprintf(
    "<p><strong>%d variable(s) improved</strong> (rRMSE stable or improved)<br>\n%s</p>\n", # nolint: line_length_linter
    length(by_status[["Improved"]]),
    tag_list(by_status[["Improved"]], "Improved")
  ))
  if (length(by_status[["Not tested"]]) > 0) {
    cat(sprintf(
      "<p><strong>%d variable(s) not tested</strong> (fewer than %d observations)<br>\n%s</p>\n", # nolint: line_length_linter
      length(by_status[["Not tested"]]), min_obs,
      tag_list(by_status[["Not tested"]], "Not tested")
    ))
  }
}
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
comparison_path <- file.path(plots_dir, "species_comparison.png")
if (file.exists(file.path(plots_fs_dir, "species_comparison.png"))) {
  cat("### Comparison plot\n\n")
  cat(sprintf(
    '<img src="%s" style="max-width:100%%; border:1px solid #ddd;">\n\n', # nolint: line_length_linter
    comparison_path
  ))
  cat(paste0(
    "::: {.callout-note}\n",
    sprintf(
      "A variable is only tested if it has at least %d observations ",
      min_obs
    ),
    sprintf(
      "(`n_obs >= %d`) over the whole species. Variables with fewer ",
      min_obs
    ),
    "observations are shown in grey (Not tested) above, get no scatter ",
    "plot below, and are not tested on the USMs of this species ",
    "either.\n",
    ":::\n\n"
  ))
}

if (length(scatter_paths) > 0) {
  cat("### Scatter plots\n\n")
  cat(paste0(
    '<div class="scatter-toggle">',
    '<button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary" ',
    'onclick="toggleScatters(true)">Expand all</button> ',
    '<button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary" ',
    'onclick="toggleScatters(false)">Collapse all</button>',
    "</div>\n\n"
  ))
}
# One collapsible block per variable, critical ones open by default. The
# iframes are lazy-loaded, so a plot is only loaded once its block is open
# and scrolled into view, instead of all of them when the page opens.
scatter_status <- if (!is.null(sp_comp)) {
  sp_comp$status[match(scatter_vars, sp_comp$variable)]
} else {
  rep(NA_character_, length(scatter_vars))
}
for (i in seq_along(scatter_paths)) {
  status <- scatter_status[i]
  badge <- if (!is.na(status) && status %in% names(tag_class)) {
    tag_list(scatter_vars[i], status)
  } else {
    sprintf("<strong>%s</strong>", scatter_vars[i])
  }
  ratio_text <- if (!is.na(scatter_ratio[i])) {
    sprintf(
      '<span class="scatter-ratio">rRMSE ratio: %+.2f%%</span>',
      scatter_ratio[i]
    )
  } else {
    ""
  }
  cat(sprintf(
    paste0(
      '<details class="scatter" id="%s"%s>\n',
      "<summary>%s %s</summary>\n",
      '<iframe src="%s" loading="lazy"></iframe>\n',
      "</details>\n\n"
    ),
    scatter_id(scatter_vars[i]),
    if (identical(status, "Critical")) " open" else "",
    badge, ratio_text, scatter_paths[i]
  ))
}
```

## USMs

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
if (!is.null(failed_usms)) {
  cat("### Failed USMs\n\n")
  explanation <- if (!is.null(usm_thresholds)) {
    sprintf(
      paste(
        "A USM (situation) is flagged as **failed** if at least one of",
        "these holds, for at least one variable on that USM (among the",
        "variables tested at the species level, i.e. with at least %d",
        "observations over the whole species):\n\n",
        "- its rRMSE ratio vs. the reference version exceeds",
        "**%s%%** (the *critical* threshold), or\n",
        "- **more than %s variables** on that USM individually exceed a",
        "lower **%s%%** *degraded* threshold.\n"
      ),
      min_obs,
      usm_thresholds$ratio_threshold, usm_thresholds$max_degraded_vars,
      usm_thresholds$degraded_threshold
    )
  } else {
    paste(
      "A USM (situation) is flagged as **failed** if at least one",
      "variable on that USM crosses a critical rRMSE ratio threshold, or",
      "if too many variables individually cross a lower degradation",
      "threshold.\n"
    )
  }
  cat(sprintf("<p>%s</p>\n\n", tag_list(sp_failed_usms, "Critical")))
  cat(paste0("::: {.callout-note}\n", explanation, ":::\n\n"))
}

# Variables not tested at the species level aren't tested on its USMs
# either (see `USMEvaluation`).
sp_not_tested <- if (!is.null(sp_comp)) {
  sp_comp$variable[sp_comp$status == "Not tested"]
}
if (length(sp_not_tested) > 0) {
  cat("### Variables not tested\n\n")
  cat(sprintf(
    "<p>%s</p>\n\n", tag_list(sp_not_tested, "Not tested")
  ))
  cat(paste0(
    "::: {.callout-note}\n",
    sprintf(
      "These variables have fewer than %d observations over the whole ",
      min_obs
    ),
    "species, so they are not tested on the USMs of this species.\n",
    ":::\n\n"
  ))
}
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
# Heatmap of the per-USM RMSE ratio used by the USM test (same formula as
# `rmse_ratio` in `USMEvaluation`: (RMSE_eval - RMSE_ref) / RMSE_species,
# restricted to the variables tested at the species level), drawn only for
# the USMs that failed that test so it matches the "Failed USMs" list above.
# Only the `max_usms` most degraded ones are shown to keep the plot readable.
max_usms <- 50
sp_usm <- if (!is.null(rrmse_per_usm)) {
  rrmse_per_usm[rrmse_per_usm$species == sp, , drop = FALSE]
}
tested_vars <- if (!is.null(sp_comp)) {
  sp_comp$variable[sp_comp$status != "Not tested"]
}
sp_rmse <- if (!is.null(species_stats)) {
  species_stats[
    species_stats$species == sp & species_stats$group == "evaluated",
    c("variable", "RMSE"),
    drop = FALSE
  ]
}
usm_ratio <- NULL
if (
  length(sp_failed_usms) > 0 && !is.null(sp_usm) &&
    length(tested_vars) > 0 && !is.null(sp_rmse) &&
    all(c("evaluated", "reference") %in% sp_usm$group)
) {
  key <- c("situation", "variable")
  usm_ratio <- merge(
    sp_usm[sp_usm$group == "evaluated", c(key, "RMSE")],
    sp_usm[sp_usm$group == "reference", c(key, "RMSE", "n_obs")],
    by = key, suffixes = c("_eval", "_ref")
  )
  usm_ratio <- merge(
    usm_ratio, stats::setNames(sp_rmse, c("variable", "RMSE_species")),
    by = "variable"
  )
  usm_ratio <- usm_ratio[
    usm_ratio$variable %in% tested_vars &
      usm_ratio$situation %in% sp_failed_usms &
      usm_ratio$RMSE_species != 0, ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
  usm_ratio$ratio <- round(
    100 * (usm_ratio$RMSE_eval - usm_ratio$RMSE_ref) / usm_ratio$RMSE_species,
    2
  )
  usm_ratio <- usm_ratio[is.finite(usm_ratio$ratio), , drop = FALSE]
}
show_heatmap <- !is.null(usm_ratio) && nrow(usm_ratio) > 0

if (show_heatmap) {
  degraded_threshold <- if (!is.null(usm_thresholds)) {
    usm_thresholds$degraded_threshold
  } else {
    20
  }
  ratio_threshold <- if (!is.null(usm_thresholds)) {
    usm_thresholds$ratio_threshold
  } else {
    50
  }

  # Most degraded USMs first: number of variables above the degraded
  # threshold, then highest ratio.
  n_degraded <- tapply(
    usm_ratio$ratio > degraded_threshold, usm_ratio$situation, sum
  )
  max_ratio <- tapply(usm_ratio$ratio, usm_ratio$situation, max)
  usms <- names(n_degraded)[order(-n_degraded, -max_ratio)]
  n_usms <- length(usms)
  usms <- utils::head(usms, max_usms)
  # Variables in the same order as the species-level comparison (most
  # degraded first).
  vars <- intersect(sp_comp$variable[order(-sp_comp$rrmse_ratio)], tested_vars)
  vars <- intersect(vars, usm_ratio$variable)
  usm_ratio <- usm_ratio[usm_ratio$situation %in% usms, , drop = FALSE]

  cells <- cbind(
    match(usm_ratio$situation, usms), match(usm_ratio$variable, vars)
  )
  z <- matrix(NA_real_, length(usms), length(vars))
  z[cells] <- usm_ratio$ratio
  hover <- matrix("No data", length(usms), length(vars))
  hover[cells] <- sprintf(
    "USM: %s<br>Variable: %s<br>Ratio: %+.1f%%<br>RMSE: %.3g (ref %.3g, species %.3g)<br>n_obs: %d", # nolint: line_length_linter
    usm_ratio$situation, usm_ratio$variable, usm_ratio$ratio,
    usm_ratio$RMSE_eval, usm_ratio$RMSE_ref, usm_ratio$RMSE_species,
    usm_ratio$n_obs
  )

  # The color scale is capped at +/- the critical threshold so that a
  # single huge ratio doesn't wash out every other cell (the exact value is
  # in the hover text). It follows the test's thresholds: green = improved,
  # white = unchanged, orange = degraded, red = critical.
  heatmap <- plotly::plot_ly(
    x = vars, y = usms, z = pmax(pmin(z, ratio_threshold), -ratio_threshold),
    type = "heatmap", text = hover, hoverinfo = "text",
    zmin = -ratio_threshold, zmax = ratio_threshold,
    colorscale = list(
      c(0, "#1e8449"), c(0.5, "#ffffff"),
      c(0.5 + degraded_threshold / (2 * ratio_threshold), "#f5b041"),
      c(1, "#c0392b")
    ),
    colorbar = list(title = "RMSE ratio (%)"),
    xgap = 1, ygap = 1,
    height = 150 + 16 * length(usms)
  ) |>
    plotly::layout(
      xaxis = list(side = "top", tickangle = -45),
      yaxis = list(autorange = "reversed", type = "category"),
      plot_bgcolor = "#f2f3f4"
    ) |>
    plotly::config(displaylogo = FALSE)

  cat("### RMSE ratio of the failed USMs\n\n")
}
```

```{r}
# widget's JS dependencies (plotly.js) in the page.
```
